abstract: Looking at each measure, the groups differ in these ways. Overall, Cardivel lowers blood pressure control compared with Standard care. Overall, Cardivel increases side effects compared with Standard care. Overall, Alvenor improves blood pressure control compared with Standard care. Overall, Alvenor increases side effects compared with Standard care.
conclusion: To sum up, the comparison of the groups shows the following. Overall, Cardivel lowers blood pressure control compared with Standard care. Overall, Cardivel increases side effects compared with Standard care. Overall, Alvenor improves blood pressure control compared with Standard care. Overall, Alvenor increases side effects compared with Standard care.
section:
### Additional comparison

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Cardivel is a tablet that slows the heart so it pushes with less force. Alvenor is a once daily tablet that relaxes the walls of the blood vessels. This comparison was run at the Oakfield Family Cohort.
